Coerce Numeric to Decorated Vector

Source: R/dvec.R
as_dvec.numeric.Rd

Coerces numeric to decorated vector. Assigns class 'dvec' and any named attributes in dots.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'numeric'
as_dvec(x, ...)

Arguments

x

numeric

...

attributes to assign

Value

dvec

See also

Other dvec: [.dvec(), [<-.dvec(), [[.dvec(), [[<-.dvec(), as.data.frame.dvec(), as_dvec(), as_dvec.character(), as_dvec.complex(), as_dvec.dvec(), as_dvec.integer(), as_dvec.logical(), c.dvec(), classified.dvec(), desolve.dvec(), explicit_guide.data.frame(), format.dvec(), implicit_guide.dvec(), implicit_guide.factor(), length.dvec(), print.dvec(), resolve.classified(), resolve.dvec(), resolve.factor(), unclassified.dvec()

Examples

as_dvec(c(10.3, 1.2))
#> [1] 10.3  1.2
as_dvec(1, label = 'yin')
#> [1] 1
#> attr(,"label")
#> [1] "yin"
as_dvec(structure(1, label = 'yin'))
#> [1] 1
#> attr(,"label")
#> [1] "yin"
as_dvec(structure(1, label = 'yin'), label = 'yang')
#> [1] 1
#> attr(,"label")
#> [1] "yang"
